final.reply_ja:
いつも大変お世話になっております。大和金物でございます。
10月15日付のご注文、誠にありがとうございます。下記の通り承りました。

全品在庫がございますので、ご指定の10月17日(土)午前中に納品いたします。
今後とも何卒よろしくお願い申し上げます。
final.reply_en:
Thank you as always for your business. This is Yamato Kanamono.
Thank you very much for your order dated October 15. We have accepted it as listed below.

All items are in stock, so we will deliver on the morning of Saturday, October 17, as requested.
We look forward to continuing to serve you.
final.summary_en: Routine order from Higashi-Osaka Seiko: 4 lines, all matched and in stock.
